description: Reads one or more attributes from one or more known DOM elements by canonical id or selector.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the target elements.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the target element in the main frame.

items.description: DOM query target identified by id, selector, or both.

targets.description: Targets to read, preserving input order in response.data.items.

anyOf.description: Attribute name to read, such as "href", "value", or "aria-checked".

items.description: Attribute name to read, such as "href", "value", or "aria-checked".

anyOf.description: Attribute names to read. An empty array reads all attributes.

attributes.description: Attribute name or names to read from every target. Use [] to read all attributes.

purpose.description: Describe why these attributes are needed, e.g., checking a link href, validating aria state, reading an input value, or debugging selector stability
